slots.context: Slot A, after the intro. Matched on article DOMAIN. Answers 'what world is this'.
slots.action: Slot B, at a mid-article section break. Matched on WORK MODE. Answers 'what is happening'.
slots.trust: Slot C, inside 'When to Call JK Prestige'. Matched on PEOPLE. Answers 'who does this for you'.

honesty_rules: Every image here is AI generated. None is a photograph of a real JK Prestige project.
Captions must never name a project, address, client, or date, and must never say 'our', 'we built', 'recent project', or 'completed'.
Captions describe the depicted ACTIVITY or CONDITION and tie it to the adjacent paragraph.
brand_visible=true images show JK Prestige marks on hardhats, trucks, or site banners. Use only in the trust slot, never beside a specific finished building that could read as a claim of authorship.
claim_risk=high images are recognizable finished buildings. Do not use them in residential how-to posts at all.
